content.value: . A textile dryer is found to consume 5m<sup>3</sup>/hr of natural gas with a calorific value of 900 kJ/mole. If the throughput of the dryer is 70 kg of wet cloth per hour, drying it from 60% moisture to 10% moisture, estimate the overall thermal efficiency of the dryer taking into account the latent heat of evaporation only (Assume reasonable value).
